gloss: novice; beginner; fledgling; just starting out

definitions.gloss: novice; beginner; fledgling; just starting out
definitions.explanation: Someone who has just entered a profession or field and is still inexperienced; a person at the beginning of their career.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧です。
{駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: I struggled when I was just starting out.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{出|だ}しだ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{甘|あま}く→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{見|み}ないで→見る：00283_miru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: Don't underestimate me just because I'm a beginner.

notes:
{駆|か}け{出|だ}し describes someone who is just starting in a profession.

FORMS:
- From ⟦{駆|か}け{出|だ}す→駆け出す：15597_kakedasu⟧ (to start running)
- Metaphor: having just "run out" into a field/profession

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + [profession]: novice [profession]
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧: novice reporter
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: fledgling actor
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧: newly practicing doctor
- {駆|か}け{出|だ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: when just starting out

USAGE:
Implies inexperience but also suggests enthusiasm and potential for growth. Often used in self-deprecating contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{玄人|くろうと}→玄人：09079_kurouto⟧: expert, professional
- ⟦{老練|ろうれん}→老練：09080_rouren⟧: experienced, seasoned
